A Croaking Cryptid#003.src: The hell are you? Some random traveler?
A Croaking Cryptid#003.dst: ¿Y tú quién demonios eres? ¿Un viajero cualquiera?

A Croaking Cryptid#004.src: Well... My job is to shoo folks like you... But I don' get to talk to people often. So let's talk.
A Croaking Cryptid#004.dst: Bueno... Mi trabajo es espantar a gente como tú... Pero no suelo tener con quién hablar. Así que hablemos.

A Croaking Cryptid#009.src: Practically everyone 'ere knows me... Some've even seen me... I'm locally feared...
A Croaking Cryptid#009.dst: Casi to'l mundo por aquí me conoce... Algunos hasta me han visto... Me temen en toa la comarca...

A Croaking Cryptid#010.src: But... It's a livin'! I'm doin' what I'm supposed to, and it's the only purpose I've ever known. Besides alcohol, 'course.
A Croaking Cryptid#010.dst: Pero... ¡Hay que ganarse la vida! Hago lo que me toca, y es el único propósito que he conocido. Aparte del alcohol, claro.

A Croaking Cryptid#012.src: Well... Yeah. It's jus' - Eugh. Dey haven't CRRRROAK IN' paid me my fair share in ages!
A Croaking Cryptid#012.dst: Bueno... Sí. Es que... Puaj. ¡Hace siglos que eyos no me pagan mi CRRRROA ÑETERA parte!

A Croaking Cryptid#013.src: Usually when someone comes to da door, it's DEM. But not today. Not for da past month.
A Croaking Cryptid#013.dst: Normalmente, cuando alguien llama a la puerta, son EYOS. Pero hoy no. Ni en todo el último mes.

A Croaking Cryptid#014.src: Say. Maybe YOU could 'elp. Dey pay me with bottles o' delicious green liquid. Forget da name. I bet you can get it elsewhere, though.
A Croaking Cryptid#014.dst: Oye. A lo mejor TÚ podrías echarme una mano. Eyos me pagan con botellas de un líquido verde delicioso. No me acuerdo del nombre. Pero seguro que lo puedes conseguir en otra parte.

A Croaking Cryptid#015.src: Dey tend to come from the east side a' the Bog. I think. Maybe if ya looked there, ya'd find the stuff I want.
A Croaking Cryptid#015.dst: Eyos suelen venir del lado este de la Ciénaga. Creo. A lo mejor, si buscas por ahí, encuentras lo que quiero.

A Croaking Cryptid#016.src: In exchange? Err... Tell ya what. I'll let'cha into my place. And we can have a nice conversation about... Er... Whatever you want, I guess.
A Croaking Cryptid#016.dst: ¿A cambio? Ehh... Te diré qué. Te dejaré entrar en mi casa. Y podremos tener una buena charla sobre... Eh... Lo que quieras, supongo.

A Croaking Cryptid#017.src: Sound like a deal? I hope so. Come back when you make some progress.
A Croaking Cryptid#017.dst: ¿Trato hecho? Eso espero. Vuelve cuando hayas avanzado algo.

A Croaking Cryptid#018.src: Who is paying you? And for w
A Croaking Cryptid#018.full: Who is paying you? And for what?

A Croaking Cryptid#021.src: Hmm... Different bottle than I'm used to... Are ya sure this is da right stuff?
A Croaking Cryptid#021.dst: Mmm... Esta botella no es la de siempre... ¿Seguro que es lo que te pedí?

A Croaking Cryptid#022.src: Well, only one way to find out, I s'pose!
A Croaking Cryptid#022.dst: ¡Bueno, solo hay una forma de saberlo, digo yo!

A Croaking Cryptid#023.src: BLECH! What is this stuff? Lemme read the label...
A Croaking Cryptid#023.dst: ¡PUAJ! ¿Qué es esta porquería? Déjame leer la etiqueta...

A Croaking Cryptid#024.src: "Liquefied Emeralds"... Do you folks DRINK this?
A Croaking Cryptid#024.dst: "Esmeraldas licuadas"... ¿La gente como tú se BEBE esto?

A Croaking Cryptid#025.src: Think ya mus' be confused by what I meant. Look east a' here. That's where dey get the stuff, I think.
A Croaking Cryptid#025.dst: Creo que no has entendido lo que te decía. Busca al este de aquí. Ahí es donde eyos consiguen la cosa, creo.

A Croaking Cryptid#026.src: "{p} Absinthe"... This ain' the stuff I'm lookin' for. Similar name, though.
A Croaking Cryptid#026.dst: "Absenta de {p}"... Esto no es lo que busco. Aunque el nombre se parece.

A Croaking Cryptid#027.src: Might suffice. Time ta try it!

A Croaking Cryptid#028.src: BLECH! Nope... It's like if tha stuff I like was made without love and joy. Awful.
A Croaking Cryptid#028.dst: ¡PUAJ! No... Es como si lo que me gusta lo hubieran hecho sin amor ni alegría. Horrible.

A Croaking Cryptid#029.src: Go look east of here. Think that's where dey get da proper stuff. Tha good stuff.
A Croaking Cryptid#029.dst: Busca al este de aquí. Creo que ahí es donde eyos consiguen la buena. La de verdad.

A Croaking Cryptid#030.src: Well - Actually no. I'm not tellin' you that. Dey told me not to tell people. But...
A Croaking Cryptid#030.dst: Bueno... Pensándolo mejor, no. Eso no te lo voy a contar. Eyos me dijeron que no se lo contara a nadie. Pero...

A Croaking Cryptid#031.src: If ya can complete our little deal, I'll tell ya whatever ya wanna know.
A Croaking Cryptid#031.dst: Si cumples con nuestro tratito, te contaré lo que quieras saber.

A Croaking Cryptid#032.src: Remember, dey bring da good stuff in wagons from the east. Ya might be able to track it down by goin' that way.
A Croaking Cryptid#032.dst: Recuerda, eyos traen la buena en carromatos desde el este. Si vas en esa dirección, a lo mejor das con ella.

A Croaking Cryptid#035.src: How may I help you on this fine day?
A Croaking Cryptid#035.dst: ¿En qué puedo ayudarte en este hermoso día?
A Croaking Cryptid#035.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#036.dst: Me parece bastante excesivo. No creo que pueda permitírmelo.
A Croaking Cryptid#036.full: That seems quite excessive. I don't think I could afford that.

A Croaking Cryptid#037.src: Consequently, that means my pricing standards are also really high. If you want even a bottle of this stuff, you'll need to give me something like... five hundred Liff Leaves?
A Croaking Cryptid#037.dst: Por tanto, mis precios también son muy altos. Si quieres aunque sea una botella, tendrás que darme algo así como... ¿quinientas hojas de Liff?
A Croaking Cryptid#037.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#039.src: Why can't I just pay you wit
A Croaking Cryptid#039.dst: ¿Por qué no puedo pagarte con esmeraldas sin más?
A Croaking Cryptid#039.full: Why can't I just pay you with emeralds?

A Croaking Cryptid#041.src: I'll have to think about it.

A Croaking Cryptid#042.src: Can you remind me of what th
A Croaking Cryptid#042.dst: ¿Me recuerdas en qué consistía el trato?
A Croaking Cryptid#042.full: Can you remind me of what the deal was?

A Croaking Cryptid#043.src: Can you remind me what to do
A Croaking Cryptid#043.dst: ¿Me recuerdas qué tengo que hacer con esta pala?
A Croaking Cryptid#043.full: Can you remind me what to do with this shovel?

A Croaking Cryptid#044.src: Got anything else you'd like to talk about?
A Croaking Cryptid#044.dst: ¿Hay algo más de lo que quieras hablar?
A Croaking Cryptid#044.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#046.src: ...Got anything else you'd like to talk about?
A Croaking Cryptid#046.dst: ...¿Hay algo más de lo que quieras hablar?
A Croaking Cryptid#046.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#048.src: Welcome back! Got anything to ask?
A Croaking Cryptid#048.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#051.src: Oh? Yep, looks like the stuff, only one way to find out!
A Croaking Cryptid#051.dst: ¿Oh? Sí, parece que es esto, ¡solo hay una forma de saberlo!

A Croaking Cryptid#052.src: Yes... Come on in, pal. Let's talk.

A Croaking Cryptid#056.src: Well, get yer questions outta the way, I guess.
A Croaking Cryptid#056.dst: Bueno, quítate las preguntas de encima, supongo.
A Croaking Cryptid#056.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#057.src: Well, where did you come fro
A Croaking Cryptid#057.full: Well, where did you come from?

A Croaking Cryptid#058.src: Or smoke cigars. Or drink.. er.. what's this stuff called? Auburn Absinthe? Yeah.
A Croaking Cryptid#058.dst: O fumar puros. O beber... eh... ¿cómo se llama esto? ¿Absenta Auburn? Eso.
A Croaking Cryptid#058.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#059.src: Not that I crrrroakin' care... Drinks and cigars are enough to keep me happy. Plus the thrill of scarin' off idiot citizens, heh.
A Croaking Cryptid#059.dst: No es que me importe un crrrroañetero pimiento... Con bebida y puros me basta para ser feliz. Y con la emoción de espantar a ciudadanos idiotas, je.
A Croaking Cryptid#059.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#060.src: Let's jus'... move on from 'at. Got anythin' else to say?
A Croaking Cryptid#060.dst: Mejor... pasemos página. ¿Tienes algo más que decir?
A Croaking Cryptid#060.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#062.src: As I said earlier, dey ain't been payin' me lately, so dey can shove it.
A Croaking Cryptid#062.dst: Como dije antes, eyos llevan un tiempo sin pagarme, así que ya pueden irse a paseo.
A Croaking Cryptid#062.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#063.src: Er. Got anythin' else to say?
A Croaking Cryptid#063.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#065.src: What's 'e do, teach the crrrroakin' alphabet?
A Croaking Cryptid#065.dst: ¿Y a qué se dedica, a enseñar el crrrroañetero alfabeto?
A Croaking Cryptid#065.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#067.src: Pal, were you crrrroakin' high or somethin'?
A Croaking Cryptid#067.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#068.src: Er. Awkward. Got anythin' else to say?
A Croaking Cryptid#068.dst: Eh. Qué incómodo. ¿Tienes algo más que decir?
A Croaking Cryptid#068.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#070.src: Welcome, customer, to the sole brewery of Auburn Absinthe!
A Croaking Cryptid#070.dst: ¡Bienvenido, cliente, a la única destilería de absenta Auburn!
A Croaking Cryptid#070.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#071.src: Why, yes I do! Only the goodest green liquid there is! My very own Auburn Absinthe!
A Croaking Cryptid#071.dst: ¡Pues claro que sí! ¡El líquido verde más buenísimo que existe! ¡Mi propia absenta Auburn!
A Croaking Cryptid#071.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#072.src: Uh. Well. I don't know about good, actually. Most people seem to hate it...
A Croaking Cryptid#072.dst: Eh. Bueno. Lo de buena no lo tengo tan claro, la verdad. A casi todo el mundo parece que le horroriza...
A Croaking Cryptid#072.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#073.src: There's like, one person who consistently comes around for it. Though they haven't shown up in a while, weirdly.
A Croaking Cryptid#073.dst: Hay como una persona que viene siempre a por ella. Aunque, qué raro, hace tiempo que no aparece.
A Croaking Cryptid#073.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#074.src: When they do come by, though, they buy a LOT. They seem to have a lot of valuable resources, so I've gotten quite rich off it!
A Croaking Cryptid#074.dst: Eso sí, cuando viene, se lleva MUCHÍSIMA. Parece tener un montón de recursos valiosos, ¡así que me he hecho bastante rica!
A Croaking Cryptid#074.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#075.src: A lot of people tell me that... Maybe I should lower the price...
A Croaking Cryptid#075.dst: Mucha gente me dice eso... Quizá debería bajar el precio...
A Croaking Cryptid#075.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#076.src: Well, not now. Can't change these things on impulse.
A Croaking Cryptid#076.dst: Bueno, ahora no. Estas cosas no se cambian por un impulso.
A Croaking Cryptid#076.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#077.src: She suddenly appears to be deep in thought...
A Croaking Cryptid#077.dst: De repente parece sumida en sus pensamientos...

A Croaking Cryptid#078.src: Aha! I've thought of a deal we can make over this. Ask me about it if you're interested.
A Croaking Cryptid#078.dst: ¡Ajá! Se me ha ocurrido un trato que podríamos hacer. {c2}Pregúntame{/} si te interesa.
A Croaking Cryptid#078.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#079.src: Alright. Hope to see you again!
A Croaking Cryptid#079.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#080.src: What??? You want to pay in emeralds??? But- but they're worthless?!
A Croaking Cryptid#080.dst: ¿¿¿Qué??? ¿¿¿Quieres pagar con esmeraldas??? Pero- ¡¿pero si no valen nada?!
A Croaking Cryptid#080.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#081.src: It would take you millions of them to equate to the value of five hundred Liff Leaves!
A Croaking Cryptid#081.dst: ¡Necesitarías millones para igualar el valor de quinientas hojas de Liff!
A Croaking Cryptid#081.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#082.src: ...Huh? They're valuable where you come from? Well, I don't know where you're from, but here, they're worth dirt.
A Croaking Cryptid#082.dst: ...¿Eh? ¿De donde vienes tienen valor? Bueno, no sé de dónde eres, pero aquí valen menos que el barro.
A Croaking Cryptid#082.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#083.src: Ah. To be honest, I don't have many... Besides... The one...
A Croaking Cryptid#083.dst: Ah. Si te soy sincera, no tengo muchas... Aparte de... Aquella...
A Croaking Cryptid#083.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#084.src: Uhm. You know the rumors about the Bog Frog?
A Croaking Cryptid#084.dst: Ehm. ¿Conoces los rumores sobre la {c2}Rana de la Ciénaga{/}?
A Croaking Cryptid#084.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#085.src: They say he's a powerful Cursed that takes the form of a Frog. There is much debate as to if he's real or not.
A Croaking Cryptid#085.dst: Dicen que es un poderoso Maldito que adopta la forma de una rana. Se discute mucho si existe o no.
A Croaking Cryptid#085.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#086.src: But... HE IS!!! ...See, usually I have to venture into the Bog to find the ingredients for Auburn Absinthe.
A Croaking Cryptid#086.dst: Pero... ¡¡¡EXISTE!!! ...Verás, normalmente tengo que adentrarme en la Ciénaga para encontrar los ingredientes de la absenta Auburn.
A Croaking Cryptid#086.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#087.src: Historically, my family has warned to stay out of the deeper parts of it, because of the rumors... But I, a young and naive child, ignored them...
A Croaking Cryptid#087.dst: Desde siempre, mi familia ha advertido que no se entre en sus partes más hondas, por los rumores... Pero yo, una niña joven e ingenua, no hice caso...
A Croaking Cryptid#087.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#088.src: It is only by the grace of the foxes that I was spared... Do not venture into the deep swamp, alright?
A Croaking Cryptid#088.dst: Solo por la gracia de los zorros salí con vida... No te adentres en lo hondo del pantano, ¿de acuerdo?
A Croaking Cryptid#088.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#090.src: Well, since you can't pay with valuable resources, there is something around here that I could ask of you instead.
A Croaking Cryptid#090.dst: Bueno, ya que no puedes pagar con recursos valiosos, hay algo por aquí que podría pedirte a cambio.
A Croaking Cryptid#090.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#091.src: See, I was out gathering the materials I use for brewing the other day, when I realized my most prized possession had gone missing.
A Croaking Cryptid#091.dst: Verás, el otro día estaba fuera recogiendo los materiales que uso para destilar cuando me di cuenta de que había perdido mi posesión más preciada.
A Croaking Cryptid#091.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#092.src: It was an heirloom passed down in my family. I hold onto it for good luck. I searched for it for hours, to no avail.
A Croaking Cryptid#092.dst: Era una reliquia que ha pasado de generación en generación. La guardo para que me dé suerte. La busqué durante horas, sin éxito.
A Croaking Cryptid#092.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#093.src: This bog is so big. And muddy. I don't know if I could ever find it. So that's where you come in!
A Croaking Cryptid#093.dst: Esta ciénaga es enorme. Y está llena de barro. No sé si podría encontrarla algún día. ¡Y ahí es donde entras tú!
A Croaking Cryptid#093.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#094.src: I think you get the point already. Find my heirloom, and I will give you an Auburn Absinthe.
A Croaking Cryptid#094.dst: Creo que ya entiendes lo esencial. {c2}Encuentra mi reliquia familiar{/} y te daré una absenta Auburn.
A Croaking Cryptid#094.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#095.src: Oh, you'll be needing this, probably.
A Croaking Cryptid#095.dst: Ah, probablemente vas a necesitar esto.
A Croaking Cryptid#095.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#096.src: Hold the shovel outside this house, and look around for sparkly spots. Dig in those spots with the shovel, and see if you can find my precious possession.
A Croaking Cryptid#096.dst: {c1}Empuña la pala{c2} fuera de esta casa y {c1}busca puntos brillantes{c2} por la zona. {c1}Cava{c2} en esos puntos con la pala y mira si encuentras mi posesión más preciada.
A Croaking Cryptid#096.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#097.src: Ah, alright. Basically, if you go outside my house while holding that shovel, you'll see a bunch of sparkly spots around the place.
A Croaking Cryptid#097.dst: Ah, vale. Básicamente, si sales de mi casa {c2}con esa pala en la mano{/}, verás un montón de puntos brillantes por la zona.
A Croaking Cryptid#097.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#098.src: Make sure you're stood directly on top of them! Digging just anywhere won't work, you know!
A Croaking Cryptid#098.dst: ¡Asegúrate de estar {c2}justo encima de ellos{/}! ¡Cavar en cualquier sitio no sirve, eh!
A Croaking Cryptid#098.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#099.src: Right-click while standing directly on top of them to dig, and see what you get! Hopefully, it'll be my heirloom.
A Croaking Cryptid#099.dst: {c1}Haz clic derecho justo encima de ellos para cavar, ¡y a ver qué sale! Con suerte, será mi reliquia familiar.{/}
A Croaking Cryptid#099.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#100.src: Wow, you forgot already? Well... Alright, I guess.
A Croaking Cryptid#100.dst: Vaya, ¿ya se te ha olvidado? Bueno... Vale, qué le vamos a hacer.
A Croaking Cryptid#100.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#101.src: I think you remember the point. Find my heirloom, and I will give you an Auburn Absinthe.
A Croaking Cryptid#101.dst: Creo que recuerdas lo esencial. {c2}Encuentra mi reliquia familiar{/} y te daré una absenta Auburn.
A Croaking Cryptid#101.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#102.src: You dug up a meaningless glass shard. You'd have to be a really strange person to keep that as an heirloom.
A Croaking Cryptid#102.dst: Has desenterrado un trozo de cristal sin importancia. Tendrías que ser una persona muy rara para guardar eso como reliquia familiar.

A Croaking Cryptid#103.src: You dug up the remains of an Auburn Absinthe bottle that you guess was disgustedly thrown to the ground. Certainly not an heirloom.
A Croaking Cryptid#103.dst: Has desenterrado los restos de una botella de absenta Auburn que, según supones, alguien tiró al suelo con asco. Desde luego, no es una reliquia familiar.

A Croaking Cryptid#104.src: You dug up a small beetle. After placing it carefully back down, you continue your search.
A Croaking Cryptid#104.dst: Has desenterrado un escarabajo pequeño. Tras volver a dejarlo con cuidado, sigues buscando.

A Croaking Cryptid#105.src: You dug up a cool-looking rock. Probably not what you're looking for, but it's neat!
A Croaking Cryptid#105.dst: Has desenterrado una roca chula. Seguramente no es lo que buscas, ¡pero mola!

A Croaking Cryptid#106.src: You dug up an Auburn Absinthe cap. Just as you're about to throw it away, you notice a string attached to it, making it a necklace. This must be it! Time to bring it back to Fia.
A Croaking Cryptid#106.dst: Has desenterrado un tapón de absenta Auburn. Justo cuando vas a tirarlo, ves que lleva un cordel atado que lo convierte en un collar. ¡Tiene que ser esto! Es hora de {c2}devolvérselo a Fia{/}.

A Croaking Cryptid#107.src: Looks like there wasn't anything there. Maybe it'd be worth trying to look for things sparkling on the ground?
A Croaking Cryptid#107.dst: Parece que ahí no había nada. ¿Quizá valga la pena buscar cosas que {c2}brillen{/} en el suelo?

A Croaking Cryptid#108.src: Oh! Yes, that's it! The cap of the first ever bottle of Auburn Absinthe...
A Croaking Cryptid#108.dst: ¡Oh! ¡Sí, es este! El tapón de la primera botella de absenta Auburn de la historia...
A Croaking Cryptid#108.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#109.src: My family's been in this business for {~} years... and yet most customers always just left disgusted.
A Croaking Cryptid#109.dst: Mi familia lleva {~} años en este negocio... y, aun así, la mayoría de los clientes siempre se iban asqueados.
A Croaking Cryptid#109.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#110.src: Maybe I should try to change the recipe..? Oh, right! The deal.
A Croaking Cryptid#110.dst: ¿Quizá debería intentar cambiar la receta...? ¡Ah, claro! El trato.
A Croaking Cryptid#110.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#111.src: Here's a fresh bottle of Auburn Absinthe! I hope you enjoy it!
A Croaking Cryptid#111.dst: ¡Aquí tienes una botella recién hecha de absenta Auburn! ¡Espero que la disfrutes!
A Croaking Cryptid#111.speaker: Fia

A Croaking Cryptid#113.src: Ya know... I'm not s'posed to let folks like you in here... Don' tell anyone you met me, capiche?
A Croaking Cryptid#113.dst: Mira... Se supone que no debo dejar entrar a gente como tú... No le digas a nadie que me has visto, ¿capiche?
A Croaking Cryptid#113.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#114.src: And you? {u}, eh? I'd say that's a strange name, but I guess I can't crrrroakin' talk.
A Croaking Cryptid#114.dst: ¿Y tú? {u}, ¿eh? Diría que es un nombre raro, pero supongo que no tengo crrrroañetero derecho a hablar.
A Croaking Cryptid#114.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#115.src: Well that's a rude crrrroakin' question to ask the guy who just let you into 'is home, eh?
A Croaking Cryptid#115.dst: Vaya crrrroañetera pregunta más grosera para el tipo que acaba de dejarte entrar en su casa, ¿eh?
A Croaking Cryptid#115.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#116.src: But I s'pose I must be some sorta freak, given the way most folks seem to react when they see me.
A Croaking Cryptid#116.dst: Pero supongo que debo de ser algún tipo de bicho raro, visto cómo reacciona casi to'l mundo al verme.
A Croaking Cryptid#116.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#117.src: I'm a frog, I guess? Except I'm much bigger and talk human.
A Croaking Cryptid#117.dst: Soy una rana, ¿supongo? Solo que mucho más grande y hablo humano.
A Croaking Cryptid#117.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#118.src: And to be honest with ya? I have no idea why I'm different to the others. I mean, I dunno if you've noticed, but dey ain't exactly fluent in human. Nor do dey wear clothes.
A Croaking Cryptid#118.dst: ¿Y si te soy sincero? No tengo ni idea de por qué soy distinto a los demás. O sea, no sé si te has fijado, pero eyos no hablan humano con mucha soltura que digamos. Ni llevan ropa.
A Croaking Cryptid#118.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#119.src: Fun question! I have no crrrroakin' clue.
A Croaking Cryptid#119.dst: ¡Qué pregunta tan divertida! No tengo ni crrrroañetera idea.
A Croaking Cryptid#119.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#120.src: I don' remember much from my early life... Hardly even my childhood. Real long time ago, see.
A Croaking Cryptid#120.dst: No me acuerdo de mucho de mis primeros años... Apenas de mi infancia. Fue hace muchísimo, ¿sabes?
A Croaking Cryptid#120.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#121.src: I was raised by this... er... weird person. Father? Mother? Couldn' really tell. Dey seemed real proud to be my parent, though.
A Croaking Cryptid#121.dst: Me crio este... eh... personaje raro. ¿Padre? ¿Madre? No sabría decirte. Eso sí, ser mi padre o madre le llenaba de orgullo.
A Croaking Cryptid#121.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#122.src: Some other folks around 'em did not seem so pleased, I remember. Maybe dey put me here 'cuz 'ey didn' want me...
A Croaking Cryptid#122.dst: Otra gente de su alrededor no parecía tan contenta, me acuerdo. A lo mejor eyos me dejaron aquí porque no me querían...
A Croaking Cryptid#122.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#123.src: Uh, yeah, we all have one, don' we? Y'know? The first person ya see when ya emerge from the tar pits?
A Croaking Cryptid#123.dst: Eh, sí, todos tenemos uno, ¿no? ¿Sabes? ¿La primera persona que ves al salir de los pozos de alquitrán?
A Croaking Cryptid#123.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#124.dst: ...¿Qué es esa mirada rara que me echas...?
A Croaking Cryptid#124.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#125.src: Not much, really. I s'pose I just sit around like a lazy crrrroakin' loser and wait for the frogs to tell me a human is in the bog.
A Croaking Cryptid#125.dst: No mucho, la verdad. Supongo que me quedo sentado como un crrrroañetero vago perdedor, esperando a que las ranas me digan que hay un humano en la ciénaga.
A Croaking Cryptid#125.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#126.src: When that happens, I gotta go outside and scare 'em off. Or well, that's usually how it goes, anyway.
A Croaking Cryptid#126.dst: Cuando eso pasa, tengo que salir a espantarlo. O bueno, así suele ir la cosa, vamos.
A Croaking Cryptid#126.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#127.src: Ah, well, dey're the ones who make me do this, I guess.
A Croaking Cryptid#127.dst: Ah, bueno, eyos son los que me obligan a hacer esto, supongo.
A Croaking Cryptid#127.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#128.src: Every couple weeks, see, some weird person with a funny mask shows up with my payment.
A Croaking Cryptid#128.dst: Cada par de semanas, ¿sabes?, aparece un tipo raro con una máscara curiosa y me trae la paga.
A Croaking Cryptid#128.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#129.src: Dey ask me details about the people I scared off. But er, don' worry, I won't tell 'em 'bout you.
A Croaking Cryptid#129.dst: Eyos me preguntan detalles de la gente que he espantado. Pero, eh, tranquilo, no les hablaré de ti.
A Croaking Cryptid#129.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#130.src: T'be honest, I don't know why dey have me doin' all that. But I don' really care, s'long as I get my fair share.
A Croaking Cryptid#130.dst: Si te digo la verdad, no sé por qué eyos me tienen haciendo todo eso. Pero me da igual, mientras cobre mi parte justa.
A Croaking Cryptid#130.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#131.src: What? Pal, I literally SAID it. How could there be any confusion???
A Croaking Cryptid#131.dst: ¿Qué? Colega, lo he DICHO tal cual. ¿¿¿Cómo puede haber confusión???
A Croaking Cryptid#131.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#132.src: It's like "Joaquin" but CROAK. Croaquin. Understand?
A Croaking Cryptid#132.dst: Es como "Joaquin", pero con CROAC. Croaquin. ¿Entiendes?
A Croaking Cryptid#132.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#133.src: ...Stop lookin' at me like that. I wasn't the one who came up with it, alright?
A Croaking Cryptid#133.dst: ...Deja de mirarme así. Yo no fui el que se lo inventó, ¿vale?
A Croaking Cryptid#133.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#145.src: Tell me more about this fella. Why'd you think I'd have any connection to 'im?
A Croaking Cryptid#145.dst: Cuéntame más de ese tipo. ¿Por qué crees que tengo algo que ver con él?
A Croaking Cryptid#145.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#146.src: ...Toad with a top hat... in a rainbow forest... speakin' cryptic nonsense?
A Croaking Cryptid#146.dst: ...¿Un sapo con chistera... en un bosque arcoíris... soltando galimatías crípticos?
A Croaking Cryptid#146.speaker: Croaquin

A Croaking Cryptid#148.src: Good to see ya again, pal. Got anythin' to say?
A Croaking Cryptid#148.dst: Me alegro de verte otra vez, colega. ¿Tienes algo que decir?
A Croaking Cryptid#148.speaker: Croaquin

A Wynnic Excavation#001.src: 'Ey, boss, ya sure this is where we need t'blow things up? There's equipment an' all here. This place been empty for a while now too.
A Wynnic Excavation#001.dst: Oye, jefe, ¿seguro que es aquí donde hay que volar esto? Aquí hay equipo y de to'. Y este sitio lleva ya un tiempo vacío.
A Wynnic Excavation#001.speaker: Miner

A Wynnic Excavation#002.src: The small spec I found might not've been much, but it could mean that there are more emeralds nearby. That's why I brought our friend here to confirm.
A Wynnic Excavation#002.dst: La pizca que encontré puede que no fuera gran cosa, pero podría significar que hay más esmeraldas cerca. Por eso he traído a nuestro amigo, para confirmarlo.
A Wynnic Excavation#002.speaker: Miner Chief

A Wynnic Excavation#003.src: Hm. Do you hear that? The sound indicates a large body of crystals just right behind these rocks.
A Wynnic Excavation#003.dst: Mm. ¿Oís eso? El sonido indica una gran masa de cristales justo detrás de estas rocas.
A Wynnic Excavation#003.speaker: Geologist

A Wynnic Excavation#006.src: Let's see 'ere... Red, purple, green n' yellow. Say, boss, ain't these them crystal that lad not too long ago asked ya 'bout?
A Wynnic Excavation#006.dst: A ver qué hay aquí... Rojo, morado, verde y amarillo. Oye, jefe, ¿no son estos los cristales esos por los que te preguntó aquel chaval hace na'?
A Wynnic Excavation#006.speaker: Miner

A Wynnic Excavation#007.src: These are not just some 'crystals'. They're... Dangerous. All of you, listen up - never speak a word of what you saw here.
A Wynnic Excavation#007.dst: Estos no son unos 'cristales' cualquiera. Son... Peligrosos. Escuchadme todos: ni una palabra de lo que habéis visto aquí.
A Wynnic Excavation#007.speaker: Miner Chief

A Wynnic Excavation#008.src: Both of you, back to your posts, now! I'll make sure these are never seen again.
A Wynnic Excavation#008.dst: ¡Vosotros dos, a vuestros puestos, ya! Yo me encargo de que nadie vuelva a ver esto.
A Wynnic Excavation#008.speaker: Miner Chief

A Wynnic Excavation#009.src: Inspecting the strange crystal sparks a memory.
A Wynnic Excavation#009.dst: Al inspeccionar el extraño cristal, te viene un recuerdo.

Aldwell Library#002.src: No medallion! What are you then, a changeling?
Aldwell Library#002.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#003.src: Can't say I've ever heard of a '{u}' before.
Aldwell Library#003.dst: No puedo decir que haya oído hablar nunca de ningún '{u}'.
Aldwell Library#003.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#004.src: Come back when you've got some proof of who you are, '{u}'.
Aldwell Library#004.dst: Vuelve cuando tengas alguna prueba de quién eres, '{u}'.
Aldwell Library#004.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#006.src: I thought I told you, you can't fool me!
Aldwell Library#006.dst: ¡Creía haberte dicho que a mí no me engañas!
Aldwell Library#006.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#007.src: Oh, you just want to know what's behind this door?
Aldwell Library#007.dst: Ah, ¿solo quieres saber qué hay detrás de esta puerta?
Aldwell Library#007.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#008.src: Fine. No harm in that, I suppose.
Aldwell Library#008.dst: Está bien. Supongo que eso no hace daño a nadie.
Aldwell Library#008.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#009.src: I'm in charge of guarding the new {p} Library!
Aldwell Library#009.dst: ¡Estoy a cargo de vigilar la nueva Biblioteca de {p}!
Aldwell Library#009.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#010.src: It's a collection of every ancient text found around Mistwood that's been put to paper.
Aldwell Library#010.dst: Es una colección de todos los textos antiguos hallados en Mistwood que se han pasado a papel.
Aldwell Library#010.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#011.dst: Y cuando digo antiguos, quiero decir antiguos.
Aldwell Library#011.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#012.src: You won't get past me, {u}. I know what you really are!
Aldwell Library#012.dst: No pasarás, {u}. ¡Sé lo que eres en realidad!
Aldwell Library#012.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#013.src: If you really want me to believe your story, I suppose there's something you could do for me...
Aldwell Library#013.dst: Si de verdad quieres que crea tu historia, supongo que hay algo que podrías hacer por mí...
Aldwell Library#013.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#014.src: Would you like to hear it?
Aldwell Library#014.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#018.src: Around {p}, there are four trees that have served as essential parts of our area's history.
Aldwell Library#018.dst: Alrededor de {p} hay cuatro árboles que han sido parte esencial de la historia de nuestra zona.
Aldwell Library#018.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#019.src: Flowers grow at their bases too, and they're used in everything from decorating our homes to making helpful remedies.
Aldwell Library#019.dst: También crecen flores a sus pies, y se usan para todo, desde decorar nuestras casas hasta preparar remedios útiles.
Aldwell Library#019.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#020.src: My personal supply is running low right now, so I'm in need of a new bouquet...
Aldwell Library#020.dst: Mi reserva personal se está agotando, así que necesito un ramo nuevo...
Aldwell Library#020.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#021.src: My task for you is to go and bring me one of each flower!
Aldwell Library#021.dst: ¡Tu tarea es ir a traerme una flor de cada árbol!
Aldwell Library#021.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#022.src: The first flower can be found under the white tree of altruism, straight east of here.
Aldwell Library#022.dst: La primera flor se encuentra bajo el blanco Árbol del Altruismo, {c2}justo al este{/} de aquí.
Aldwell Library#022.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#023.src: The second flower blooms inside the tree of community, which is growing all around us!
Aldwell Library#023.dst: ¡La segunda flor brota dentro del Árbol de la Comunidad, que está creciendo {c2}todo a nuestro alrededor{/}!
Aldwell Library#023.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#024.src: The third flower grows by the carcass of the tree of renewal, which lies to the south of this library.
Aldwell Library#024.dst: La tercera flor crece junto al cadáver del Árbol de la Renovación, que yace {c2}al sur de esta biblioteca{/}.
Aldwell Library#024.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#025.src: The final flower can be found at the base of the tree of resistance, which the Canopy call their home.
Aldwell Library#025.dst: La última flor se encuentra al pie del Árbol de la Resistencia, al que {c2}el Dosel llama hogar{/}.
Aldwell Library#025.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#026.src: Come back to me with all four of them, and perhaps we could work something out from there.
Aldwell Library#026.dst: Vuelve con las cuatro y quizá podamos llegar a algún acuerdo.
Aldwell Library#026.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#027.src: Have you got me what I asked for yet?
Aldwell Library#027.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#028.src: No? Well, come back when you do.
Aldwell Library#028.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#029.src: If you need a reminder, the first flower can be found under the white tree of altruism, straight east of here.
Aldwell Library#029.dst: Por si necesitas que te lo recuerde, la primera flor se encuentra bajo el blanco Árbol del Altruismo, {c2}justo al este{/} de aquí.
Aldwell Library#029.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#030.src: The second flower blooms inside the tree of community, which grows all around us!
Aldwell Library#030.dst: ¡La segunda flor brota dentro del Árbol de la Comunidad, que crece {c2}todo a nuestro alrededor{/}!
Aldwell Library#030.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#031.src: The third flower grows in the carcass of the tree of renewal, which lies to the south of this library.
Aldwell Library#031.dst: La tercera flor crece en el cadáver del Árbol de la Renovación, que yace {c2}al sur de esta biblioteca{/}.
Aldwell Library#031.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#033.src: I hope that you find them all for the next time we speak.
Aldwell Library#033.dst: Espero que las hayas encontrado todas para la próxima vez que hablemos.
Aldwell Library#033.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#035.src: I'm sure I'll find a use for them soon.
Aldwell Library#035.dst: Seguro que pronto les encuentro alguna utilidad.
Aldwell Library#035.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#036.src: In the meantime, enjoy access to the {p} Library!
Aldwell Library#036.dst: Mientras tanto, ¡disfruta del acceso a la Biblioteca de {p}!
Aldwell Library#036.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#038.src: I don't care what you are any more, just go through to the library...
Aldwell Library#038.dst: Ya me da igual lo que seas, tú pasa a la biblioteca...
Aldwell Library#038.speaker: Aldwell

Aldwell Library#040.src: It seems to be a book about the different clans in the region, though a little dated- it says it was written in {~} NA. Still, could be fun to flick through.
Aldwell Library#040.dst: Parece un libro sobre los distintos clanes de la región, aunque algo anticuado: dice que se escribió en el {~} NA. Aun así, puede ser divertido hojearlo.

Aldwell Library#041.src: ...That's the end of that passage. Read another?

Aldwell Library#042.src: The Canopy is a merger of three independent clans, the Owls, Foxes, and Deers, who were among the oldest clans in the forest, and had a longstanding rivalry.
Aldwell Library#042.dst: {c1}El Dosel es la fusión de tres clanes independientes, los Búhos, los Zorros y los Ciervos, que se contaban entre los clanes más antiguos del bosque y mantenían una larga rivalidad.{/}

Aldwell Library#043.src: Prior to the Cutoff, the Owls were led by Sovereign Caetal, who ruled over the entire {p}, though the Foxes and Deers also vied for the position.
Aldwell Library#043.dst: {c1}Antes del Aislamiento, los Búhos estaban liderados por el Soberano Caetal, que gobernaba todo {p}, aunque los Zorros y los Ciervos también se disputaban el puesto.{/}

Aldwell Library#044.src: Each of the three clans had its own strength. The Foxes were adept combatants. The Deers, strategic geniuses. And the owls, stealth.
Aldwell Library#044.dst: {c1}Cada uno de los tres clanes tenía su propia fortaleza. Los Zorros eran hábiles combatientes. Los Ciervos, genios de la estrategia. Y los Búhos, maestros del sigilo.{/}

Aldwell Library#045.src: ...Despite this, Caetal was a man of the people. His blessing of voice helped him rally the community together. The three clans became close, and what had once been a bitter rivalry became a friendly one.
Aldwell Library#045.dst: {c1}...Aun así, Caetal era un hombre del pueblo. Su bendición de la voz lo ayudó a unir a la comunidad. Los tres clanes se acercaron, y lo que antes fue una rivalidad encarnizada se volvió amistosa.{/}

Aldwell Library#047.src: After the discovery of the first Changeling, and its subsequent execution, Caetal was removed from his post, and the {p}, cut off from the outside world. Caetal would then disappear.
Aldwell Library#047.dst: {c1}Tras el descubrimiento del primer cambiaformas y su posterior ejecución, Caetal fue destituido y {p}, aislado del mundo exterior. Después, Caetal desaparecería.{/}

Aldwell Library#048.src: The three clans were mortified to have lost the man who brought them so close together, and combined into one group, The Canopy.
Aldwell Library#048.dst: {c1}Los tres clanes quedaron desolados al perder al hombre que tanto los había unido, y se fusionaron en un solo grupo: el Dosel.{/}

Aldwell Library#049.src: The Canopy has, ever since, been a proactive enemy of the Queen, and their masks have become symbols of resistance against the Changeling threat.
Aldwell Library#049.dst: {c1}Desde entonces, el Dosel ha sido un enemigo activo de la Reina, y sus máscaras se han convertido en símbolos de resistencia frente a la amenaza de los cambiaformas.{/}

Aldwell Library#050.src: The Kalkalrah Clan is a clan that lives in the further reaches of the {p}, composed of mercenaries-for-hire. They keep no alliances, as they only help whoever pays them.
Aldwell Library#050.dst: {c1}El clan Kalkalrah vive en los confines de {p} y está formado por mercenarios a sueldo. No mantienen alianzas, pues solo ayudan a quien les paga.{/}

Aldwell Library#051.src: When paid, however, they make up for it well, being some of the most skilled fighters in the region. Generally, they are hired for the task of helping guard.
Aldwell Library#051.dst: {c1}Eso sí, cuando se les paga, cumplen con creces, ya que son algunos de los luchadores más hábiles de la región. Por lo general, se les contrata como apoyo en labores de guardia.{/}

Aldwell Library#052.src: The only exception they make is that they refuse to assist in anti-crown activities, as they wish not to become a target for the Queen's military.
Aldwell Library#052.dst: {c1}Su única excepción es que se niegan a colaborar en actividades contra la Corona, pues no desean convertirse en blanco del ejército de la Reina.{/}

Aldwell Library#053.src: The Peacekeeper's Clan are a group that lives in {p} directly, comprised of those who wish to keep the town a neutral and safe hub for all clans to come together, and a quiet place for citizens to live.
Aldwell Library#053.dst: {c1}El clan de los Pacificadores es un grupo que vive directamente en {p}, formado por quienes desean que el pueblo siga siendo un punto de encuentro neutral y seguro para todos los clanes y un lugar tranquilo para sus ciudadanos.{/}

Aldwell Library#054.src: Members are usually local volunteers who align with the clan's overarching goal, and want to lend a hand. It has a democratic structure, with leaders chosen by the clan itself.
Aldwell Library#054.dst: {c1}Sus miembros suelen ser voluntarios locales que comparten el objetivo general del clan y quieren echar una mano. Tiene una estructura democrática, y sus líderes los elige el propio clan.{/}

Aldwell Library#055.src: The Peacekeepers maintain a doctrine of neutrality with other clans, as they do not want to be seen as an enemy to any other clan in the woods. This has earned them high favour with practically everyone.
Aldwell Library#055.dst: {c1}Los Pacificadores mantienen una doctrina de neutralidad hacia los demás clanes, pues no quieren que ningún otro clan del bosque los vea como enemigos. Esto les ha granjeado el aprecio de prácticamente todo el mundo.{/}

Aldwell Library#056.src: The Lostheth Clan are a clan of beast-tamers, residing in the outskirts of {p}.
Aldwell Library#056.dst: {c1}El clan Lostheth es un clan de domadores de bestias que reside en las afueras de {p}.{/}

Aldwell Library#057.src: Up until recent times, the Lostheth clan were a very obscure group, and they were on the verge of disbandment due to lack of interest.
Aldwell Library#057.dst: {c1}Hasta hace poco, el clan Lostheth era un grupo muy desconocido, al borde de la disolución por falta de interés.{/}

Aldwell Library#058.src: However, with the appearance of Adasaurs around the {p}, this all changed. The Lostheth Clan, masters of beast-taming, were quickly able to bring the creatures under their control.
Aldwell Library#058.dst: {c1}Sin embargo, todo cambió con la aparición de los Adasaurios en {p}. El clan Lostheth, maestro en la doma de bestias, no tardó en someter a estas criaturas.{/}

Aldwell Library#059.src: In doing so, they pioneered the practice of riding on their backs. This quickly became a subject of interest to other clans, as well as many citizens, and the Lostheth clan went from being nobodies to one of the best-known clans in the woods.
Aldwell Library#059.dst: {c1}Al hacerlo, fueron pioneros en la práctica de montar sobre su lomo. Esto despertó pronto el interés de otros clanes y de muchos ciudadanos, y el clan Lostheth pasó de no ser nadie a ser uno de los clanes más conocidos del bosque.{/}

Aldwell Library#060.src: This book is called "The Four Virtuous Trees"
Aldwell Library#060.dst: Este libro se titula {c2}"Los cuatro árboles virtuosos"{/}.

Aldwell Library#061.src: It's some kind of guide both to survival and morals. Give it a read?
Aldwell Library#061.dst: Es una especie de guía de supervivencia y de moral. ¿Leerlo?

Aldwell Library#062.src: This book is called "The World Outside The Woods".
Aldwell Library#062.dst: Este libro se titula {c2}"El mundo más allá del bosque"{/}.

Aldwell Library#063.src: It seems to be a book from {~} KA, talking about other regions. Would you like to read it?
Aldwell Library#063.dst: Parece un libro del {~} KA que habla de otras regiones. ¿Quieres leerlo?

Aldwell Library#064.src: ...That's the end of the introduction. Read another part of the book?
Aldwell Library#064.dst: ...Ahí acaba la introducción. ¿Leer otra parte del libro?

Aldwell Library#065.src: There are also various illustrations and maps of the {p}, but it looks almost identical to the {p} of today. Read more of the book?
Aldwell Library#065.dst: También hay varias ilustraciones y mapas de {p}, pero apenas difiere de lo que es {p} hoy. ¿Seguir leyendo el libro?

Aldwell Library#066.src: Next to this description, there is a collection of illustrations of the region. It's completely unrecognizable to you. Read more of the book?
Aldwell Library#066.dst: Junto a esta descripción hay una colección de ilustraciones de la región. Te resulta completamente irreconocible. ¿Seguir leyendo el libro?

Aldwell Library#067.src: Accompanying the text are sketches of these "great mines," but, as stated by the text, it looked pretty much the same as the regions around it. Read more of the book?
Aldwell Library#067.dst: Acompañan al texto unos bocetos de estas "grandes minas", pero, tal como dice el texto, se parecía mucho a las regiones de alrededor. ¿Seguir leyendo el libro?

Aldwell Library#068.src: There are drawings of the {p} alongside the text. It looks pretty much the same as you saw it on the way to the tournament, though there may be slight differences. Read more of the book?
Aldwell Library#068.dst: Junto al texto hay dibujos de {p}. Se parece mucho a lo que viste de camino al torneo, aunque puede haber ligeras diferencias. ¿Seguir leyendo el libro?

Aldwell Library#069.src: With the text, there are pictures of Aelumia. Though you didn't get to see too much of the city during the tournament, it looks somewhat different to what you remember. Read more of the book?
Aldwell Library#069.dst: Junto al texto hay imágenes de Aelumia. Aunque durante el torneo no llegaste a ver mucho de la ciudad, se ve algo distinta a como la recuerdas. ¿Seguir leyendo el libro?

Aldwell Library#070.src: It has been {~} years since our freedom to leave these woods was taken from us, and already, many of our youngest are wondering what the lands beyond are like.
Aldwell Library#070.dst: {c1}Han pasado {~} años desde que nos arrebataron la libertad de salir de estos bosques, y muchos de nuestros jóvenes ya se preguntan cómo son las tierras del otro lado.{/}

Aldwell Library#071.src: We elders have been a capable source of information on this matter, but the world is changing. We are dying out. And so, I have decided to write down what I know, so it may be passed down for future generations to learn from.
Aldwell Library#071.dst: {c1}Los ancianos hemos sido una fuente de información fiable sobre este asunto, pero el mundo está cambiando. Nos estamos extinguiendo. Por eso he decidido escribir lo que sé, para que se transmita y las generaciones futuras puedan aprender de ello.{/}

Aldwell Library#072.src: In the northwest lies the {p}, a vast woodland filled with trees whose leaves take on a warmer colour than the green leaves found on the few deciduous trees in the {p}.
Aldwell Library#072.dst: {c1}Al noroeste se extiende {p}, un vasto bosque de árboles cuyas hojas adquieren un color más cálido que las hojas verdes de los pocos árboles caducifolios de {p}.{/}

Aldwell Library#073.src: A river runs through the region, though its water is limited by a colossal dam in the east.
Aldwell Library#073.dst: {c1}Un río atraviesa la región, aunque su caudal está limitado por una colosal presa al este.{/}

Aldwell Library#074.src: Tradition has it that, once upon a time, the forest's leaves were green, much like ours, but the reduced flow of water has caused them to lose colour and die, giving them their redder hues.
Aldwell Library#074.dst: {c1}Cuenta la tradición que, antaño, las hojas del bosque eran verdes, muy parecidas a las nuestras, pero que el menor caudal de agua hizo que perdieran color y murieran, lo que les dio sus tonos más rojizos.{/}

Aldwell Library#075.src: There are also legends of a tree bigger than any of ours, from before the Cursed Age. Its stump remains now, the only proof of its existence.
Aldwell Library#075.dst: {c1}También hay leyendas sobre un árbol más grande que cualquiera de los nuestros, anterior a la Edad Maldita. Hoy solo queda su tocón, la única prueba de su existencia.{/}

Aldwell Library#076.src: The {p} is home to many such traditions, as its people are the most spiritual of any region. The ruins of an ancient temple sit in the northern reaches of the area, holding much value to its god-fearing folk.
Aldwell Library#076.dst: {c1}{p} alberga muchas de estas tradiciones, pues su gente es la más espiritual de todas las regiones. Las ruinas de un antiguo templo se alzan en el norte de la zona, de gran valor para sus gentes temerosas de los dioses.{/}

Aldwell Library#077.src: This temple is likewise believed to predate the Cursed Age, though its purpose is unknown, so the citizens ascribe various traditions to it. The Crown condemns many of these traditions as heretic in nature, though they persist regardless.
Aldwell Library#077.dst: {c1}También se cree que este templo es anterior a la Edad Maldita, aunque se desconoce su propósito, por lo que los ciudadanos le atribuyen diversas tradiciones. La Corona condena muchas de ellas por heréticas, pero persisten de todos modos.{/}

Aldwell Library#078.src: The biggest town in the {p} is {p}, which sits on the boundary with the Agricultural District and is where most traded goods from said region arrive. A large fox statue sits in the town square, serving as a distinct local landmark.
Aldwell Library#078.dst: {c1}La mayor población de {p} es {p}, situada en la frontera con el Distrito Agrícola y adonde llega la mayoría de los productos comerciados desde esa región. En la plaza del pueblo hay una gran estatua de zorro, un hito local inconfundible.{/}

Aldwell Library#079.src: Just to the west of the {p}, still visible from the highest trees at the border, is the Agricultural District.
Aldwell Library#079.dst: {c1}Justo al oeste de {p}, aún visible desde los árboles más altos de la frontera, se encuentra el Distrito Agrícola.{/}

Aldwell Library#080.src: This name was given to it by the Crown to distinguish it as a region dedicated to agriculture on the behalf of the rest of the province, though some within refer to it by the less stiff, older name "Tolas."
Aldwell Library#080.dst: {c1}La Corona le dio este nombre para distinguirla como región dedicada a la agricultura en beneficio del resto de la provincia, aunque algunos de sus habitantes la llaman por su nombre antiguo y menos rígido, "Tolas".{/}

Aldwell Library#081.src: As previously stated, this region is a designated farm zone, where all citizens labour to produce food for the other regions.
Aldwell Library#081.dst: {c1}Como ya se ha dicho, esta región es una zona agrícola designada, donde todos los ciudadanos trabajan para producir alimentos para las demás regiones.{/}

Aldwell Library#082.src: Since we were severed from the rest of Fruma, we have stopped receiving the fruits of this labour, though sometimes anti-government clans manage to steal such products from the many Crown supply wagons that pass through the area.
Aldwell Library#082.dst: {c1}Desde que nos separaron del resto de Fruma, hemos dejado de recibir los frutos de este trabajo, aunque a veces los clanes antigubernamentales logran robar dichos productos de los muchos carros de suministros de la Corona que cruzan la zona.{/}

Aldwell Library#083.src: Tolas' many farms are built upon a beautiful, open, sprawling plain, where wildlife such as deer live in relative harmony with humans.
Aldwell Library#083.dst: {c1}Las numerosas granjas de Tolas se asientan sobre una llanura hermosa, abierta y extensa, donde fauna como el ciervo convive en relativa armonía con los humanos.{/}

Aldwell Library#084.src: Although the people there make open their growing dissatisfaction with Sovereign Amastli's traditionalist policy, they generally live happy lives.
Aldwell Library#084.dst: {c1}Aunque sus habitantes expresan abiertamente su creciente descontento con la política tradicionalista del Soberano Amastli, en general llevan una vida feliz.{/}

Aldwell Library#085.src: To the south are the Great Mines. As the name would suggest, this section of the province has long been devoted to quarrying for resources. and, like the Agricultural District, is home to a full populace of workers.
Aldwell Library#085.dst: {c1}Al sur se encuentran las Grandes Minas. Como su nombre indica, esta parte de la provincia lleva mucho tiempo dedicada a la extracción de recursos y, al igual que el Distrito Agrícola, alberga una población enteramente trabajadora.{/}

Aldwell Library#086.src: The actual surface geography of the Great Mines is mostly indistinct from its neighbours.
Aldwell Library#086.dst: {c1}La geografía de superficie de las Grandes Minas apenas se distingue de la de sus vecinas.{/}

Aldwell Library#087.src: What differentiates the region from others is the number of valuable natural resources under the ground. As such, a wall has been built to indicate the divide between there and here.
Aldwell Library#087.dst: {c1}Lo que diferencia a esta región de las demás es la cantidad de valiosos recursos naturales bajo tierra. Por ello se construyó un muro que marca la división entre allí y aquí.{/}

Aldwell Library#088.src: Most of the area's citizens live in the central mining hub, Deraj, rather than any smaller settlements as seen in other regions. Since the end of the Cursed Age, they have been endlessly, passionately mining for Fruma.
Aldwell Library#088.dst: {c1}La mayoría de los habitantes de la zona vive en el núcleo minero central, Deraj, y no en asentamientos más pequeños como los de otras regiones. Desde el fin de la Edad Maldita, extraen mineral para Fruma sin descanso y con pasión.{/}

Aldwell Library#089.src: At the beginning of the Knowledge Age, when Sovereign Oru ascended, these mining operations intensified, in search of Cinnabar. Some parts of the Great Mines have since become quite worn down.
Aldwell Library#089.dst: {c1}A comienzos de la Edad del Conocimiento, cuando el Soberano Oru ascendió, estas labores mineras se intensificaron en busca de cinabrio. Desde entonces, algunas partes de las Grandes Minas han quedado bastante desgastadas.{/}

Aldwell Library#090.src: North of the {p} are the {p}, the most affluent region of Fruma. This region is a hilly moor home to all kinds of gorgeous flowers and other such plants, including trees with fruits that flower pink.
Aldwell Library#090.dst: {c1}Al norte de {p} se encuentran {p}, la región más rica de Fruma. Es un páramo de colinas que alberga toda clase de flores preciosas y otras plantas, incluidos árboles frutales de flor rosa.{/}

Aldwell Library#091.src: The area is embroiled in a constant soft power struggle among various influential families, though one particular family - called the Nasins - have quite consistently maintained supremacy. Their patriarch, Gitephe, is the region's Sovereign.
Aldwell Library#091.dst: {c1}La zona vive en una constante pugna de poder blando entre varias familias influyentes, aunque una en particular, los Nasin, ha mantenido la supremacía de forma bastante constante. Su patriarca, Gitephe, es el Soberano de la región.{/}

Aldwell Library#092.src: Within this region is the gate to {p}, and so, a large amount of the province's trade must pass through it.
Aldwell Library#092.dst: {c1}En esta región se encuentra la puerta de {p}, por lo que gran parte del comercio de la provincia debe pasar por ella.{/}

Aldwell Library#093.src: This is problematic for the Crown, as the {p} are the only way up into the {p}, and our clans frequently attempt to rob supply wagons.
Aldwell Library#093.dst: {c1}Esto es un problema para la Corona, pues {p} son la única vía de subida a {p}, y nuestros clanes intentan a menudo asaltar los carros de suministros.{/}

Aldwell Library#094.src: Though it neighbours the {p}, they are separated from one another by a sheer difference in height, where the {p} stands.
Aldwell Library#094.dst: {c1}Aunque linda con {p}, ambas regiones quedan separadas por un desnivel abrupto, donde se alza {p}.{/}

Aldwell Library#095.src: The presence of this dam has led to what once was a river becoming a large lake, at the edge of which the region's capital city, {p}, is situated.
Aldwell Library#095.dst: {c1}Esta presa hizo que lo que antes era un río se convirtiera en un gran lago, a cuya orilla se sitúa la capital de la región, {p}.{/}

Aldwell Library#096.src: This region is also home to a great variety of fascinating creatures, though, contrary to popular folkloric belief, there aren't any winged snakes.
Aldwell Library#096.dst: {c1}Esta región también alberga una gran variedad de criaturas fascinantes aunque, contra lo que dice la creencia popular, no existe ninguna serpiente alada.{/}

Aldwell Library#097.src: In the very heart of Fruma is {p}, the capital city of the province, and home of the Queen. It rests atop a plateau overlooking the surrounding regions, so its looming wall is not a sight unique to our woods.
Aldwell Library#097.dst: {c1}En pleno corazón de Fruma se encuentra {p}, capital de la provincia y hogar de la Reina. Se alza sobre una meseta que domina las regiones vecinas, por lo que su imponente muralla no es una vista exclusiva de nuestros bosques.{/}

Aldwell Library#098.src: Being in the city is a very unique experience. It is completely unlike the quiet life we live in the woods. There is almost no nature around at all, only buildings; not an inch of land has not been used for construction.
Aldwell Library#098.dst: {c1}Estar en la ciudad es una experiencia muy singular. No se parece en nada a la vida tranquila que llevamos en el bosque. Casi no hay naturaleza, solo edificios; no hay un palmo de tierra sin construir.{/}

Aldwell Library#099.src: Among the many noteworthy places in the citadel are the military's headquarters, the Royal University, and the Queen's palace.
Aldwell Library#099.dst: {c1}Entre los muchos lugares destacables de la ciudadela están el cuartel general del ejército, la Universidad Real y el palacio de la Reina.{/}

Aldwell Library#100.src: Those few fortunate enough to see the inside of the palace described it as the height of luxury, exceeding even their wildest imagination. It's a shame that none from these woods may ever see such beauty again.
Aldwell Library#100.dst: {c1}Los pocos afortunados que han visto el interior del palacio lo describieron como el colmo del lujo, más allá de su imaginación más desbordada. Es una lástima que nadie de estos bosques pueda volver a ver tanta belleza.{/}

Aldwell Library#101.src: According to legends passed down from our forefathers, the plateau was once the best place in the world for viewing the night sky, as the view was almost completely without obstructions.
Aldwell Library#101.dst: {c1}Según las leyendas transmitidas por nuestros antepasados, la meseta fue en su día el mejor lugar del mundo para contemplar el cielo nocturno, pues las vistas estaban casi libres de obstáculos.{/}

Aldwell Library#102.src: Today, this is no longer true, as the famous city wall obscures most of this view. However, the University is said to have a place for viewing the stars that sees above this border.
Aldwell Library#102.dst: {c1}Hoy ya no es así, pues la famosa muralla tapa la mayor parte de estas vistas. Sin embargo, se dice que la Universidad tiene un lugar para observar las estrellas por encima de ese límite.{/}

Aldwell Library#103.src: ...It seems to be some sort of children's story book. Would you like to read it?
Aldwell Library#103.dst: ...Parece una especie de libro de cuentos infantiles. ¿Quieres leerlo?

Aldwell Library#104.src: This book is called "Sight of Sasha".
Aldwell Library#104.dst: Este libro se titula {c2}"La mirada de Sasha"{/}.

Aldwell Library#105.src: Once upon a time, in the land of Uthak, there lived a little boy named Nannah, or so his people called him.
Aldwell Library#105.dst: {c1}Érase una vez, en la tierra de Uthak, un niño pequeño llamado Nannah, o así lo llamaba su gente.{/}

Aldwell Library#106.src: Nannah was a troublesome, mischievous boy, who always disobeyed his elders, and lied to get out of trouble.
Aldwell Library#106.dst: {c1}Nannah era un niño revoltoso y travieso que siempre desobedecía a sus mayores y mentía para librarse de los problemas.{/}

Aldwell Library#107.src: One day, his mother took him out foraging in the woods. The woods were a dangerous place, and Nannah had to stay close for his own safety. But he did not want to do that.
Aldwell Library#107.dst: {c1}Un día, su madre lo llevó a recolectar al bosque. El bosque era un lugar peligroso, y Nannah debía quedarse cerca por su propia seguridad. Pero él no quería hacerlo.{/}

Aldwell Library#108.src: When his dear mother was busy picking berries, Nannah ran out into the woods, seeking his own adventure, though he did not travel very far, because shortly after he departed, he was stopped by a voice.
Aldwell Library#108.dst: {c1}Cuando su querida madre estaba ocupada cogiendo bayas, Nannah echó a correr por el bosque en busca de su propia aventura, aunque no llegó muy lejos, pues poco después de partir lo detuvo una voz.{/}

Aldwell Library#109.src: "Nannah, you must stop," said the voice, "It is not good to misbehave."
Aldwell Library#109.dst: {c1}"Nannah, debes detenerte", dijo la voz. "No está bien portarse mal."{/}

Aldwell Library#110.src: Nannah turned to the source of the voice, up in the trees. Two big, blue eyes stared back, and the eyes belonged to an owl with beautiful white feathers. "Who are you?" asked Nannah.
Aldwell Library#110.dst: {c1}Nannah se volvió hacia el origen de la voz, en lo alto de los árboles. Dos grandes ojos azules le devolvieron la mirada, y pertenecían a un búho de preciosas plumas blancas. "¿Quién eres?", preguntó Nannah.{/}

Aldwell Library#111.src: "I am Sasha," said the owl, "The judge of Uthak. You must listen to your elders, Nannah, they know best."
Aldwell Library#111.dst: {c1}"Soy Sasha", dijo el búho, "el juez de Uthak. Debes escuchar a tus mayores, Nannah, ellos saben más."{/}

Aldwell Library#112.src: Nannah responded, "Why, Sasha? I have traveled far from my mother, yet I am fine. She was wrong; these woods are safe."
Aldwell Library#112.dst: {c1}Nannah respondió: "¿Por qué, Sasha? Me he alejado mucho de mi madre, y estoy bien. Se equivocaba; este bosque es seguro."{/}

Aldwell Library#113.src: "Because, Nannah, monsters like me eat naughty children like you. I have been watching your behaviour for a long time, with my eyes that pierce the mists. You must stop being such a disrespectul boy, or else you may become my dinner."
Aldwell Library#113.dst: {c1}"Porque, Nannah, los monstruos como yo comen niños malos como tú. Llevo mucho tiempo observando tu conducta con mis ojos, que atraviesan la niebla. Debes dejar de ser un niño tan irrespetuoso, o puede que acabes siendo mi cena."{/}

Aldwell Library#114.src: Nannah was frightened by this, and ran back to where his mother was. He found her there, calling his name. "Nannah? Nannah!!!" she yelled.
Aldwell Library#114.dst: {c1}Nannah se asustó y volvió corriendo a donde estaba su madre. La encontró allí, llamándolo. "¿Nannah? ¡¡¡Nannah!!!", gritaba.{/}

Aldwell Library#115.src: When Nannah approached her, she was very disappointed in him. "You cannot go running off into the forests, Nannah," she said, "It is not safe!"
Aldwell Library#115.dst: {c1}Cuando Nannah se acercó, ella se mostró muy decepcionada. "No puedes salir corriendo por el bosque, Nannah", le dijo. "¡No es seguro!"{/}

Aldwell Library#116.src: Nannah promised her that he would never venture into the forest alone again. "Are you sure, Nannah?" she said, "A promise is something you ought not break."
Aldwell Library#116.dst: {c1}Nannah le prometió que nunca volvería a adentrarse solo en el bosque. "¿Seguro, Nannah?", dijo ella. "Una promesa es algo que no se debe romper."{/}

Aldwell Library#117.src: He agreed, and they went home. But, that night, Nannah could not sleep, for an idea kept circling his mind.
Aldwell Library#117.dst: {c1}Él asintió, y volvieron a casa. Pero esa noche Nannah no pudo dormir, pues una idea no dejaba de rondarle por la cabeza.{/}

Aldwell Library#118.src: "Stupid Sasha," he thought, "Nobody should tell me what I can and cannot do!"
Aldwell Library#118.dst: {c1}"Estúpido Sasha", pensó. "¡Nadie debería decirme lo que puedo y no puedo hacer!"{/}

Aldwell Library#119.src: Nannah, not wanting to be bossed around by the owl, made his decision. He got up from his bed, and tip-toed out of his house. He would break his promise he made to his mother, and ignore Sasha's recommendation.
Aldwell Library#119.dst: {c1}Nannah, que no quería que el búho le diera órdenes, tomó una decisión. Se levantó de la cama y salió de casa de puntillas. Rompería la promesa que le hizo a su madre e ignoraría el consejo de Sasha.{/}

Aldwell Library#120.src: The forest was dark at night, and barely anything could be seen. The only things Nannah could make out were the Candleferns that dotted the forests.
Aldwell Library#120.dst: {c1}De noche, el bosque estaba oscuro y apenas se veía nada. Lo único que Nannah alcanzaba a distinguir eran los Candlefern que salpicaban el bosque.{/}

Aldwell Library#121.src: Despite the danger of getting lost, Nannah could not bring himself to admit defeat and head home. He walked from Candlefern to Candlefern, for several minutes, until the quiet sounds of the village were gone. It was silent.
Aldwell Library#121.dst: {c1}Pese al peligro de perderse, Nannah no fue capaz de darse por vencido y volver a casa. Caminó de Candlefern en Candlefern durante varios minutos, hasta que los suaves sonidos de la aldea desaparecieron. Reinaba el silencio.{/}

Aldwell Library#122.src: "Hello again," said a familiar voice, "I see you have not learned."
Aldwell Library#122.dst: {c1}"Hola de nuevo", dijo una voz conocida. "Veo que no has aprendido."{/}

Aldwell Library#123.src: "Sasha???" yelped Nannah, "How did you get here? I didn't hear you!"
Aldwell Library#123.dst: {c1}"¿¿¿Sasha???", chilló Nannah. "¿Cómo has llegado hasta aquí? ¡No te he oído!"{/}

Aldwell Library#124.src: "I am one with the winds, Nannah, my flight is as silent as the mist itself. Nobody can ever hear my approach. It makes me very good at catching naughty children to have for my dinner."
Aldwell Library#124.dst: {c1}"Soy uno con los vientos, Nannah; mi vuelo es tan silencioso como la propia niebla. Nadie puede oírme jamás cuando me acerco. Por eso se me da muy bien atrapar niños traviesos para la cena."{/}

Aldwell Library#125.src: Before he knew it, Nannah had been lifted off his feet, and was brought through the darkness to Sasha's wicker nest, never to be seen again.
Aldwell Library#125.dst: {c1}Sin darse cuenta, Nannah se vio alzado del suelo y llevado a través de la oscuridad hasta el nido de mimbre de Sasha, y nunca más se le volvió a ver.{/}

Aldwell Library#126.src: The mist of our forest home is dense and widespread; many get lost trying to find their way through the fog. As such, our people have devised various methods to remember the area better.
Aldwell Library#126.dst: {c1}La niebla de nuestro hogar en el bosque es densa y extensa; muchos se pierden intentando orientarse en ella. Por ello, nuestra gente ha ideado varios métodos para recordar mejor la zona.{/}

Aldwell Library#127.src: One popular method is learning the Virtuous Trees, a group of distinct trees throughout the woods that embody a set of precepts.
Aldwell Library#127.dst: {c1}Un método popular es aprender los Árboles Virtuosos, un grupo de árboles singulares repartidos por el bosque que encarnan una serie de preceptos.{/}

Aldwell Library#128.src: Knowing each of these trees means that they can be used as a reference point if you are lost. They also provide great teachings to live by.
Aldwell Library#128.dst: {c1}Conocer cada uno de estos árboles permite usarlos como punto de referencia si te pierdes. También ofrecen grandes enseñanzas para la vida.{/}

Aldwell Library#129.src: First is the Tree of Community, the single tree specimen that {p} is built around. Indeed, the trees of {p} are in fact one single specimen, grown from one tree in what is called a "clonal colony."
Aldwell Library#129.dst: {c1}El primero es el Árbol de la Comunidad, el único ejemplar alrededor del cual se construyó {p}. De hecho, los árboles de {p} son en realidad un solo ejemplar, surgido de un árbol en lo que se llama una "colonia clonal".{/}

Aldwell Library#130.src: This tree represents the importance of community and family; that, despite our differences, and our aggressions, we are all one, and must ultimately cooperate to build each other up.
Aldwell Library#130.dst: {c1}Este árbol representa la importancia de la comunidad y la familia: que, pese a nuestras diferencias y agresiones, todos somos uno y, en última instancia, debemos cooperar para elevarnos unos a otros.{/}

Aldwell Library#131.src: Second is the Tree of Altruism, a distinctly different Redwood thanks to its small size and white leaves.
Aldwell Library#131.dst: {c1}El segundo es el Árbol del Altruismo, una secuoya claramente distinta por su pequeño tamaño y sus hojas blancas.{/}

Aldwell Library#132.src: This tree is in fact an Albino Redwood, and it is believed that its frail appearance is the result of an assistance it provides to its fellow trees.
Aldwell Library#132.dst: {c1}Este árbol es en realidad una secuoya albina, y se cree que su aspecto frágil se debe a la ayuda que presta a los árboles que la rodean.{/}

Aldwell Library#133.src: It is located in the far east side of the {p}, and demonstrates that we should strive to help others, even if at great personal cost.
Aldwell Library#133.dst: {c1}Se encuentra en el extremo oriental de {p} y demuestra que debemos esforzarnos por ayudar a los demás, aunque nos cueste mucho.{/}

Aldwell Library#134.src: Third is the Tree of Renewal, a truly ancient tree that is believed to be one of the first trees in the forest, and among the tallest of all. It is thought to have lived through countless disasters, and healed from each.
Aldwell Library#134.dst: {c1}El tercero es el Árbol de la Renovación, un árbol verdaderamente antiguo que se cree que fue uno de los primeros del bosque y uno de los más altos de todos. Se piensa que ha sobrevivido a incontables desastres y se ha curado de todos ellos.{/}

Aldwell Library#135.src: The Tree of Renewal shows that we should take time to rest and heal; to prioritize our own wellbeing when it is necessary, rather than solely sticking to altruism alone.
Aldwell Library#135.dst: {c1}El Árbol de la Renovación enseña que debemos tomarnos tiempo para descansar y sanar; anteponer nuestro bienestar cuando sea necesario, en vez de aferrarnos únicamente al altruismo.{/}

Aldwell Library#136.src: Fourth and final is the Tree of Resistance, a towering, resilient tree that is home to The Canopy Clan.
Aldwell Library#136.dst: {c1}El cuarto y último es el Árbol de la Resistencia, un árbol altísimo y tenaz que es el hogar del clan del Dosel.{/}

Aldwell Library#137.src: Though outwardly unremarkable, its location is important to consider. It stands in deforested land, yet lives on, thriving despite the destruction of its habitat. It symbolizes our collective resistance to oppressors.
Aldwell Library#137.dst: {c1}Aunque por fuera no tiene nada de especial, conviene tener en cuenta su ubicación. Se alza en tierra deforestada y, aun así, sigue vivo y prospera pese a la destrucción de su hábitat. Simboliza nuestra resistencia colectiva frente a los opresores.{/}

Aldwell Library#138.src: Remember these trees, and their virtues. It may save your life, and guide you to great friendships.
Aldwell Library#138.dst: {c1}Recuerda estos árboles y sus virtudes. Pueden salvarte la vida y guiarte hacia grandes amistades.{/}

An Unexpected Departure#001.src: This plaque has clearly seen erosion over time, but you can still make out most of the text.
An Unexpected Departure#001.dst: Esta placa ha sufrido claramente la erosión con el paso del tiempo, pero aún puedes distinguir la mayor parte del texto.

An Unexpected Departure#002.src: "This monument has been built in memory of those who perished following a terrible attack initiated by enemies of the state."
An Unexpected Departure#002.dst: "Este monumento se erigió en memoria de quienes perecieron tras un terrible ataque perpetrado por enemigos del Estado."

An Unexpected Departure#003.src: "Forever shall the workers have strength, and rise above those who wish to destroy our glorious way of life."
An Unexpected Departure#003.dst: "Que los trabajadores tengan fuerza por siempre y se alcen sobre quienes desean destruir nuestra gloriosa forma de vida."

An Unexpected Departure#004.src: The rake collides with the statue, damaging it a bit.
An Unexpected Departure#004.dst: El rastrillo choca contra la estatua y la daña un poco.

An Unexpected Departure#006.dst: Quizá haya una forma de entrar.

An Unexpected Departure#007.src: The rope tenses under the weight of the log.
An Unexpected Departure#007.dst: La cuerda se tensa bajo el peso del tronco.

An Unexpected Departure#008.src: The rope starts to fray, adding any more weight will make it snap.
An Unexpected Departure#008.dst: La cuerda empieza a deshilacharse; si añades más peso, se romperá.

An Unexpected Departure#009.src: It looks like there's enough space in this to fit at least three items.
An Unexpected Departure#009.dst: Parece que aquí hay espacio suficiente para al menos tres objetos.

An Unexpected Departure#010.src: The guards have found our position. We must make our escape sooner than originally planned.
An Unexpected Departure#010.dst: Los guardias han descubierto nuestra posición. Debemos escapar antes de lo previsto.
An Unexpected Departure#010.speaker: Markus

An Unexpected Departure#011.src: There is little time left, gather everything you need and board the escape craft. Now!
An Unexpected Departure#011.dst: Queda poco tiempo: reúne todo lo que necesites y sube a la nave de escape. ¡Ya!
An Unexpected Departure#011.speaker: Markus

An Unexpected Departure#012.src: They found us. One of our members was caught smuggling supplies for the escape.
An Unexpected Departure#012.dst: Nos han encontrado. Atraparon a uno de los nuestros pasando suministros de contrabando para la huida.

An Unexpected Departure#013.src: We cannot prepare for any longer. We must leave immediately.
An Unexpected Departure#013.dst: No podemos seguir preparándonos. Debemos partir de inmediato.

An Unexpected Departure#014.src: As the night approaches, so does our last day in these hopeless lands.
An Unexpected Departure#014.dst: A medida que se acerca la noche, también se acerca nuestro último día en estas tierras sin esperanza.

An Unexpected Departure#015.src: We are almost ready, there are only a few final improvements we must add to our escape craft.
An Unexpected Departure#015.dst: Ya casi estamos listos; solo quedan unas pocas mejoras finales que hacerle a nuestra nave de escape.

An Unexpected Departure#016.src: If we fail to escape, it will mean almost certain death for us.
An Unexpected Departure#016.dst: Si no logramos escapar, nos espera una muerte casi segura.

An Unexpected Departure#017.src:
Finnegan
I need to bring that book!
An Unexpected Departure#017.speaker: Finnegan

An Unexpected Departure#019.src:
Rella
Hurry up! The craft is ready.
An Unexpected Departure#019.dst:
Rella
¡Daos prisa! La nave está lista.
An Unexpected Departure#019.speaker: Rella

An Unexpected Departure#020.src:
Capulus
There's no way they found us!
An Unexpected Departure#020.dst:
Capulus
¡No puede ser que nos hayan encontrado!
An Unexpected Departure#020.speaker: Capulus

An Unexpected Departure#021.src:
Oliver
I hope this launcher works.
An Unexpected Departure#021.dst:
Oliver
Espero que este lanzador funcione.
An Unexpected Departure#021.speaker: Oliver

An Unexpected Departure#022.src:
Tony
I was enjoying that sandwich...
An Unexpected Departure#022.dst:
Tony
Y yo que estaba disfrutando de ese bocadillo...
An Unexpected Departure#022.speaker: Tony

An Unexpected Departure#023.src:
Eris
We didn't even finalize the design...
An Unexpected Departure#023.dst:
Eris
Ni siquiera terminamos el diseño...
An Unexpected Departure#023.speaker: Eris

An Unexpected Departure#024.src:
Capulus
We don't have much time!
An Unexpected Departure#024.speaker: Capulus

An Unexpected Departure#025.src:
Eris
It should still work... right?
An Unexpected Departure#025.speaker: Eris

An Unexpected Departure#026.src:
Rella
No need to dwell on the design. We're leaving.
An Unexpected Departure#026.dst:
Rella
No hace falta darle más vueltas al diseño. Nos vamos.
An Unexpected Departure#026.speaker: Rella

An Unexpected Departure#027.dst:
Oliver
Esto ni siquiera va a funcionar...
An Unexpected Departure#027.speaker: Oliver

An Unexpected Departure#029.src:
Lynn
Can't wait to get out of this awful place.
An Unexpected Departure#029.dst:
Lynn
Tengo unas ganas enormes de salir de este horrible lugar.
An Unexpected Departure#029.speaker: Lynn

An Unexpected Departure#030.src:
Tony
Should make sure this beam doesn't break.
An Unexpected Departure#030.dst:
Tony
Habrá que asegurarse de que esta viga no se rompa.
An Unexpected Departure#030.speaker: Tony

An Unexpected Departure#031.src:
Eris
I think I forgot my wrench.
An Unexpected Departure#031.dst:
Eris
Creo que se me ha olvidado la llave inglesa.
An Unexpected Departure#031.speaker: Eris

An Unexpected Departure#032.src:
Finnegan
Dammit! Where did I put that book?
An Unexpected Departure#032.dst:
Finnegan
¡Maldita sea! ¿Dónde he puesto ese libro?
An Unexpected Departure#032.speaker: Finnegan

An Unexpected Departure#034.src:
Rella
Pack up what you can!
An Unexpected Departure#034.speaker: Rella

An Unexpected Departure#035.src:
Lynn
Just need to get a few final supplies...
An Unexpected Departure#035.dst:
Lynn
Solo me faltan unos últimos suministros...
An Unexpected Departure#035.speaker: Lynn

An Unexpected Departure#037.src:
Eris
They can't possibly catch us.
An Unexpected Departure#037.dst:
Eris
Es imposible que nos atrapen.
An Unexpected Departure#037.speaker: Eris

An Unexpected Departure#038.src:
Rella
You don't need that book. Come already!
An Unexpected Departure#038.dst:
Rella
No necesitas ese libro. ¡Ven ya!
An Unexpected Departure#038.speaker: Rella

An Unexpected Departure#040.src:
Finnegan
I'm running out of time!
An Unexpected Departure#040.speaker: Finnegan

An Unexpected Departure#042.src:
Oliver
We can't stay here for long.
An Unexpected Departure#042.dst:
Oliver
No podemos quedarnos aquí mucho tiempo.
An Unexpected Departure#042.speaker: Oliver

An Unexpected Departure#043.src: "Stolen fabric from nearby factories. Must be strong and heat resistant."
An Unexpected Departure#043.dst: "Tela robada de las fábricas cercanas. Debe ser resistente y soportar el calor."

An Unexpected Departure#044.src: "Fabric will be cut into strips, which will then be connected to form the balloon."
An Unexpected Departure#044.dst: "La tela se cortará en tiras, que luego se unirán para formar el globo."

An Unexpected Departure#046.src: "Possible design for a burner. Must be facing up into the balloon, and will likely last at least {~} minutes."
An Unexpected Departure#046.dst: "Posible diseño de un quemador. Debe apuntar hacia arriba, hacia el interior del globo, y probablemente durará al menos {~} minutos."

An Unexpected Departure#047.src: "Will create hot air that rises into the balloon, which should provide enough lift to allow the craft to ascend."
An Unexpected Departure#047.dst: "Generará aire caliente que subirá hacia el globo, lo que debería proporcionar sustentación suficiente para que la nave ascienda."

An Unexpected Departure#048.src: The following text looks like a set of instructions for creating this device, but it appears to have been torn apart.
